method_limits: This iteration completes 12/12 synthetic offline tabletop tasks and 48/48 shutdown, takeover, temporary-record disposal and return-to-human-service assertions. It proves that the machine-readable handover route can be executed and audited under participant control; it does not prove field safety, measured accessibility, public acceptance, legal compliance, procurement readiness or authority approval. Field rehearsal remains 0/12. Responsible organisation types are defined but no legal entities are appointed. Scale ranges are magnitudes derived directly from the submitted geometry and funding is given only as an estimate class; neither is a priced quotation or a budget commitment, and actual amounts must be fixed by at least three quotations once tenure, permission and scale are settled. Colour-vision separation of the figure fills has been measured (Viénot 1999 simulation plus CIEDE2000) and the corridor plan now prints its land-use codes so the drawing no longer relies on hue alone; real-user testing with low-vision and colour-deficient participants has not been done. Site boundaries, key areas, land use, movement, buildings and phasing remain provisional conceptual design inputs pending official data and professional review.
